known.title: Allow history GET requests without a CSRF header

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - a signed-in admin reads history or downloads its CSV. Both GET endpoints use `admin_only`, which unconditionally calls `verify_csrf(request)` in `src/forge/templates/starter-python/apps/api/app/core/admin.py:21`. Consequently, ordinary GET requests without an `x-csrf-token` header receive 403 `CSRF_CHECK_FAILED`. This breaks both new HTTP tests and the browser's CSV download link, which cannot supply that header. Separate admin authorization from CSRF enforcement for these read-only endpoints while retaining CSRF checks on mutations.
